convert_dot_to_svg: convert a Graphviz DOT source string to cleaned SVG output using the dot command
configure_font_settings: configure the font name and font size used for DOT to SVG rendering
convert_dot_to_sized_svg: convert a DOT source string to SVG with a custom CSS size style attribute
convert_dot_to_attributed_svg: convert a DOT source string to SVG with custom SVG element attributes
convert_pt_to_em: convert a point value to rem units based on the configured font size
